campaign.label: Campaign Operations
campaign.summary: Wings of the Goddess Campaign: ops overseers, Sigil NPCs, the Ops menu, 246 op missions, Campaign Battles, evaluation/promotion, voting and rewards. This workspace maps all research so far onto a graph and lists, with a status and a validation mark per item. Unknowns stay marked unknown.
campaign.compare: Each mission, NPC and menu event is tracked with a build status and a validation mark; compare against captures before marking anything ok.
